script.name: webdeps_hyp
script.objective: [H1-a] Gateway alone, no backends: must stay alive (no 'panicked at') and answer a clean error or 5xx within 5 s.

script.name: webdeps_hyp
script.objective: [H1-b] Gateway with fake backends sending garbage, invalid JSON, empty body and a 10 MB body: alive after each case.

script.name: webdeps_hyp
script.objective: [H1-c] Backends and gateway up, service-go then service-cs killed: gateway survives and returns an error status.

script.name: webdeps_hyp
script.objective: [H2-a] service-go with a fake peer that accepts and never replies; FAIL if still blocked at 15 s.

script.name: webdeps_hyp
script.objective: [H2-b] service-cs with a stalled fake peer; FAIL if still blocked at 15 s.

script.name: webdeps_hyp
script.objective: [H2-c] service-cs and service-go with the upstream answering 500, then refusing: FAIL if 200 (error swallowed).

script.name: webdeps_hyp
script.objective: [H3-a] tapi_netexpose listeners per process: FAIL on 0.0.0.0 or :: or a port outside the hardcoded set.

script.name: webdeps_hyp
script.objective: [H3-b] tapi_egress with an allow-list of the hardcoded loopback endpoints: FAIL on any other destination.

script.name: webdeps_hyp
script.objective: [H3-c] tapi_binscan of the three binaries, informational only, never fails.
